clusters.label: Attendance, presence and seat accounting
clusters.rationale: The presence/absence data model and the two derived-truth properties (effective seat count, on-demand instance materialization) every attendance and calendar-capacity view reads from.

clusters.label: Auth, session and access control
clusters.rationale: Everything that decides who a request is from, what they may see, how their session survives across requests and app backgrounding, and how their client caches the data that authorization shapes.

clusters.label: Backend-api operational safety guards
clusters.rationale: Two independent fail-closed startup guards in create_app: a hardcoded CORS origin allowlist and a check that refuses to run migrations against a production host.

clusters.label: backend-models cross-cutting shape decisions
clusters.rationale: The three structural decisions that shape nearly every model in this scope: junction tables implemented as full id-bearing rows, coach_id-based data isolation, and the invitation/vacancy persistence shape.

clusters.label: Coach dashboard and settings gating
clusters.rationale: The block-composed coach home screen and the single source of truth that decides which surfaces (dashboard blocks included) a coach-only account may reach.

clusters.label: Playwright E2E suite infrastructure
clusters.rationale: One Playwright suite was split into three extraction scopes (web-e2e-a/b/c) that all import these shared helpers and coordinate fixture placement against one shared levelup_test database.

clusters.label: Internationalization coverage
clusters.rationale: The PT-default/EN-fallback i18n bootstrap shared by both clients, and the backend's parallel guarantee that every rendered notification is locale-correct.

clusters.label: Invitation, vacancy and eligibility engine
clusters.rationale: Every mechanism that decides whether and in what order a vacant class seat gets offered to a student, end to end across backend models/services/api and the web client.

clusters.label: Legacy declarative admin editor
clusters.rationale: The original Field/Block/Tab/Form-declared, generic-CRUD admin editor that predates the product's purpose-built screens and still backs ~30 model files.

clusters.label: Messaging and realtime delivery
clusters.rationale: Chat delivery and unread tracking ride the same SSE mechanism the invitation engine and dashboard use to push live updates to an open client.

clusters.label: Mobile Pressable/Portal accessibility composition
clusters.rationale: Two scopes independently document the same iOS accessibility-subtree-collapse constraint on nested Pressables, connected by a semantically-similar-to edge rather than a merge (distinct concrete patterns: hand-rolled Portal overlays vs. plain sibling toggles).

clusters.label: Mobile app shell bootstrap and live-data resume
clusters.rationale: The fixed startup sequence app/_layout.tsx runs before any screen mounts, and the paired AppState/SSE fix that keeps a backgrounded-then-foregrounded app's data and socket alive.

clusters.label: Mobile ui/ primitives vs. their web source of truth
clusters.rationale: Two documented, unresolved divergences between the mobile react-native-reusables port and its web shadcn/ui source: card.tsx applies a shadow web's source comment forbids, and badge.tsx uses rounded-full where web reserves that shape for filter controls only.

clusters.label: Mobile native-rendering platform constraints
clusters.rationale: Two documented, non-obvious react-native-reusables/Reanimated/NativeWind rendering limits this app has hit and worked around in its ui/ primitives.

clusters.label: Player identity and access boundaries
clusters.rationale: Who owns a player's credential (PAD-105) sits alongside the broader coach-scoped authorization boundary that governs everything else a coach can and cannot do to a player's record.

clusters.label: Reminder and scheduling lifecycle
clusters.rationale: The APScheduler-driven reminder state machine and the two correctness guarantees it depends on: DST-safe club-local day boundaries and non-blank locale-correct message rendering.

clusters.label: Season-bounded recurring classes
clusters.rationale: A recurring class's occurrences are capped by its covering season and only materialize into concrete rows on demand - two halves of the same recurrence-safety story.

clusters.label: Web calendar interaction safety and scope choice
clusters.rationale: Two coach-facing calendar interaction guarantees: warnings that inform but never hard-block a risky booking action, and the single/future scope choice offered on every edit of a recurring item.

clusters.label: Duplicated web UI editing surfaces
clusters.rationale: Two independently-built-and-not-reconciled duplications in the web client: two report-dialog mount points with no shared state, and two separately-implemented player-edit surfaces (plus a second strengths/weaknesses duplication).

clusters.label: Cross-platform design system
clusters.rationale: The single token source, the visual conventions built on it, and the platform-by-platform porting discipline (and occasional drift) that keeps web and iOS looking like one product.

clusters.label: Web mock/real data switch and thin re-export barrels
clusters.rationale: The dominant USE_MOCK_DATA branch pattern across apps/web/src/api/*.ts, and its sibling pattern for the subset of resources with no mock behavior to add.

clusters.label: Settings page authoring patterns
clusters.rationale: The Settings page's three cross-cutting concerns: the reimplemented-three-times editable-ordered-list card pattern, the invitation engine's coach-facing config surface, and the single source of truth gating which sections a coach-only vs. player account can reach.
